Introduction

Lee Ji-yeon, better known under the stage name Izykite, also formerly known as EASYKITE, is a singer-songwriter under Neuron Music. She debuted as a solo artist on February 3, 2021, with her digital single Belated Regret.

Her stage name is a blend of her given name and the English words "easy" and "kite."
